capabilities: Import Tradovate, TradeSea and TradingView Replay exports without duplicate trades
Add manual trades with partial exits and correct recorded executions
Collect chart screenshots in a Print Queue and attach them to trades
Review trades against an automatic checklist and track finished reviews
Show equity curve, performance calendar and breakdowns on Home
disambiguation: Not a book exchange or reading tracker; it records futures trades, accounts and their reviews.
extras: Settings and account configuration live in data.json, which uninstalling removes; a settings backup can be exported and imported under Advanced. Mobile loading is enabled but phone and tablet layouts still need work.
motivation: I'm building Tradebook to keep trades, screenshots and reviews together in Obsidian.
problem: Trade records, chart screenshots and post-trade reviews otherwise live in separate tools, with no single place to see what happened and why.

relations.evidence: Tradovate Orders and Fills, with Cash History when you have it available for matching recorded costs.
The TradeSea orders export, one checked export per import batch.

summary: Local-first futures trading journal that imports broker exports, keeps trades as Markdown notes with screenshots, and reviews results.
